checkpoints.name: top_is_core
checkpoints.description: The top module is `core`: a clocked datapath with a data-in bus and a result bus.

checkpoints.name: two_register_slots
checkpoints.description: The core holds two register slots (u_ra, u_rb) — two instances of the same `regslot` module. This is the fan-out lesson: one `regslot` design, reused twice.

checkpoints.name: core_instantiates_the_blocks
checkpoints.description: `core` is assembled from two module types: the register slot and the ALU.

checkpoints.name: alu_internals
checkpoints.description: Push into u_alu. The ALU computes A+B and A&B and selects between them with a mux on `op` — three cells: $add, $and, $mux.

checkpoints.name: slot_is_a_flop
checkpoints.description: Push into a register slot. It is a single enabled, async-reset flip-flop bank — one $adffe cell.
